beats.care: UoH ranked third among central universities, after BHU and Delhi University. Big W if you're eyeing research in Hyderabad.
beats.what: Thirty-one University of Hyderabad researchers made the 2026 Stanford and Elsevier list, often called the world's top two percent scientists.
beats.why: The list is built from how often other researchers cite their work, across 174 subject areas.

cards.body: Nine names come from chemistry and nine from life sciences. Computer science has four, physics three. The list uses Scopus citation data across 20 broad fields.
Two of the 31 are from English, a humanities subject, on a list dominated by science.

cards.q: Would you pick a college for its research ranking?

opts: Other scientists cite their work a lot
cards.q: What does making this list mostly show?
cards.why: Being cited often means other researchers build on your work, a sign of influence.

hook: 31 Hyderabad researchers made a *world's top 2%* list. What does that mean?
